ladder.label: DOWNTREND
ladder.why: Failed cycle — price broke below the low that started this cycle, which historically means the larger trend is rolling over (~80% of cases). Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Stand aside until a new daily cycle low forms and confirms.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 31 · failed · daily cycle broke its start low 5d ago).
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds
⚠ Failed cycle — price broke below the low that began this cycle (5d ago)
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Prior cycle topped early (a tiring-trend hint)

entry.text: Downtrend — stand aside until a new cycle low forms and confirms.
entry.text_zh: 下跌趋势——观望，直至新的周期低点形成并确认。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 19 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 19 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 31 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: overdue — the bigger cycle is stretched, expect more volatility
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 31 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 逾期——更大的周期已被拉伸，预计波动加剧
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 失败周期——价格跌破了启动本周期的低点，历史上这通常意味着更大的趋势正在掉头向下（约 80% 的情形）。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 观望，直至新的日线周期低点形成并确认。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量为负；投资者周期失败（跌破起始低点）；投资者周期已逾期；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 31 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期于 5 天前跌破其起始低点）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：下跌趋势。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
宏观：美国净流动性中性——对概率属无方向性影响
⚠ 失败周期——价格跌破了启动本周期的低点（5 天前）
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
仍位于 10 日均线之下
上一周期见顶偏早（趋势走弱的暗示）
ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ DOWNTREND signal just triggered today (fresh cross from NEARING A LOW). Signal strength: strong (score -90/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 下跌趋势信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自接近低点翻转）。 信号强度：强（评分 -90/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：稳健卖出/离场形态（-50）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

profile.description: Lululemon, commonly styled as lululemon, is a Canadian-American multinational athletic apparel retailer headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia, and incorporated in Delaware, United States, as Lululemon Athletica Inc.
